derivation:
by
  simpa only [Filter.lift, iInf_prod, iInf_subtype] using
    (le_iInf_comp (fun p : f.sets × f.sets => g p.1 p.2) (fun s => (s, s)))
explanation: After unfolding lift, this is the inequality restricting an indexed infimum to diagonal pairs. le_iInf_comp supplies that inequality independently.
